name: The Missing Orders
summary: Dispatch Commander Ruag sends you to find Bengor after the orders go missing.

sections.title: Ruag's Account
sections.body: Dispatch Commander Ruag bristles when you ask about the missing orders. He says they went with the soldiers sent to carry them. Murlocs ambushed and brutally beat the soldiers, and only one survived. Bengor can barely speak, cannot walk, and is fed through a tube. Ruag sends you to find him nearby, then warns you to mind what you poke your nose into.

sections.title: Bengor's Halting Words
sections.body: Bengor can manage only broken scraps of speech. Among them, you catch the words swamp talker.

faq.q: Who sent the orders that went missing?
faq.answer: Dispatch Commander Ruag says the orders went with the soldiers sent out. He grows defensive when you ask what became of them.

faq.q: What happened to the soldiers carrying the orders?
faq.answer: Dispatch Commander Ruag says murlocs ambushed and brutally beat the soldiers carrying the orders. Only one survived.
Bengor is the sole survivor of the ambush. He can barely speak, cannot walk, and is fed through a tube.
Dispatch Commander Ruag says Bengor is somewhere nearby.
